versions.changelog:
- Initial release of ai-content-audit skill.
- Audits content libraries for low-quality, trust-eroding AI-generated filler.
- Produces an audited inventory with per-piece verdicts (keep, enrich, rewrite, delete/redirect), detection signals, and a triage plan.
- Installs a publishing quality gate for future AI-assisted content.
- Focuses on actionable, evidence-based auditing—origin-blind on "keeper" pieces.
- Outlines clear anti-patterns and mandatory quality checks for trustworthy triage.
